ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, nav labels, logo, icon strokes, and every text-level heading — sets the full information hierarchy

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surface, and hero overlay text — the default background for almost every screen

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle form inputs, tag surfaces, and quiet secondary panel backgrounds — barely-there neutral

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

coral.$description: Coral — Category tag fills (Downloads, News) — flat rectangular badges that classify content without padding the layout

teal.$description: Teal — Category tag fills (Tutorials, Videos) — flat rectangular badges paired with coral to split content taxonomy visually

futura-pt.$description: The single typeface powering everything from body copy to 90px display headlines. Futura PT's geometric precision mirrors Ableton's grid-based music software — the type and the product share a visual logic. Weight 700 carries headlines, 400 carries body. No serif, no monospace secondary face — the system stays mono-typographic.
